description: An installed app's window opens the folder it is handed at launch with the page's own engine (ADR-0540). Launching permits the window into that folder's scope; the folder plugin then grants it the directory and reads and changes it, and the shell runs that folder's history as one `epicenter` child per operation, only for a folder the window was granted (status, history, save_version, sync, settle_sync, ADR-0559). Approving an app trusts it fully, so this is wiring, not a sandbox. The window listens for the folder plugin's change event, epicenter-folder://changed.
